input.free_text_description: This system is a search platform that serves User, Content Creator roles. The platform provides capabilities for date time type handler, video, like. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include content management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to receive notifications about important events, so that I can stay informed and respond promptly.
As a User, I want to interact with like functionality, so that I can accomplish my like-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with collect functionality, so that I can accomplish my collect-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with tag functionality, so that I can accomplish my tag-related tasks.
